name: Sublime Electric
about:
Sublime Electric has served the Greater Boise area from its Boise, Idaho headquarters since 2007. The company was established as a licensed electrical contractor and has built a reputation for reliable residential and commercial electrical services.

The firm provides a full range of electrical installation, repair, and maintenance services. Its licensed electricians handle lighting upgrades, EV charger installation (Level 1, 2, and 3), electrical panel repair and replacement, whole-home surge protection, and backup generator installation. The team also supports commercial remodeling and construction projects. All work is performed by electricians who have completed apprenticeship training and state licensing requirements.

Sublime Electric serves homeowners and businesses throughout the Boise metro area. Residential customers rely on the company for EV charging solutions, lighting redesigns, panel upgrades, and emergency repairs. Commercial clients engage the firm for new construction wiring, tenant improvements, and ongoing maintenance. The company cites its BBB accreditation and 24/7 emergency response as key factors in customer retention.

The company emphasizes warranted installations, free estimates for major projects, and a community-focused approach that prioritizes safety and code compliance. Its electricians evaluate each job for load capacity and fire risk, particularly when adding circuits or upgrading panels.

name: Summers Manufacturing, Inc.
old_description: Proven agricultural equipment, built to perform when it matters most.
about:
Summers Manufacturing, Inc. is based in Devils Lake, North Dakota. The company traces its roots to 1965 when Harley Summers purchased patent rights for Goebel truck and pickup hoists and began production in a small shop in Maddock, ND. He incorporated the business as Summers Manufacturing Company, Inc. in 1969. In 2007, the company became 100 percent employee-owned through an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

The company designs and manufactures a range of agricultural equipment, including tillage tools (vertical tillage, variable-rate tillage, disk rippers, chisel plows, harrows, and rolling choppers), land rollers (coil packers, hydraulic-fold and trail-type Super Rollers), application equipment (Spray Fill Xpress sprayer fill systems, grain handling conveyors, and field belts), mounted attachments (harrows, rolling baskets, rolling choppers), and rock pickers. Production takes place at its Devils Lake campus, which includes a 26,000-square-foot factory built in 1980 and expanded multiple times through 2010, and an Aberdeen, South Dakota facility added in 2013 for assembly, parts, and distribution.

Summers serves the agricultural sector, selling its equipment to farmers and through a dealer network across North America. The company collaborates with research and technology partners such as Grand Farm (Fargo, ND), AgRevival (Gibbon, MN), PTI (Pontiac, IL), and Mach to develop variable-rate tillage and precision agriculture solutions.

The company emphasizes field-tested durability, citing its 2000 introduction of the industry's first true vertical tillage tool (the Supercoulter) and a 10-year limited warranty on select land roller models launched in 2018. Its stated mission is to build field-tested tough equipment that helps farmers feed and fuel the world.

name: Summon Electronics INC
old_description: Part Genie solves complex sourcing fast - with traceability, margin logic, and shelf-ready packs baked in.
about:
Summon Electronics operates from Longwood, Florida, where it began as an open-market sourcing partner for contract manufacturers and OEMs. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available materials.

The firm specializes in procuring hard-to-find and obsolete electronic components — semiconductors, ICs, FPGAs, microcontrollers, passives, connectors, relays, power supplies, and MRO items — while maintaining inventory programs that include blanket and scheduled orders. It also provides instant PCB assembly quotes via BOM upload, PPAP support with traceability documentation, engineering assistance, in-house cable assembly and reeling, and ESD/MSL-compliant packaging.

Its customer base spans OEM buyers, contract manufacturers, transit authorities, specialty lighting manufacturers, temperature-component vendors, and generator assembly contractors. Case studies cite a discontinued part delivered in three days, a rebuilt supply chain for a transit authority, custom LED strips for a retro pinball project, and verified precision resistors for thermal sensor designs.

Summon positions itself as a frontline partner rather than a traditional distributor, emphasizing real-time human support, kanban systems to keep production moving, and a sourcing engine (branded Part Genie) that returns traceability paperwork, margin compliance, and shelf-pack strategies alongside pricing.

name: SunDay Solar
old_description: In our fifteen years as a business we’ve shown thousands of customers how they can benefit from the power of the sun.
about:
SunDay Solar operates from Charlottesville, Virginia, where it has served residential and commercial customers for fifteen years as a locally owned, family-run business. The company was founded on the premise of guiding property owners through the transition to solar energy, handling every step from initial evaluation to final activation.

The firm designs and installs custom photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses, including battery backup solutions such as the Enphase 10T. Its service division performs comprehensive system inspections, inverter and junction-box cleaning, wiring resealing, and critter-guard installation to protect against pest damage. Crews also manage all permitting, utility interconnection paperwork, and county inspections, and they provide ongoing monitoring with quarterly check-ins.

Customers range from homeowners seeking energy independence to small businesses and nonprofit organizations such as Feeding Greene, Inc. The company frequently services "orphaned" arrays whose original installers have ceased operations, diagnosing inverter faults and restoring production for systems it did not originally install.

SunDay Solar emphasizes a turnkey approach that bundles design, installation, permitting, and long-term monitoring under a single point of contact. A ten-year workmanship warranty and included quarterly monitoring are cited as core commitments, reflecting the founders' goal of remaining accountable throughout the system's lifespan.

name: SunPeak
old_description: Businesses trust SunPeak as their long-term solar energy partner.
about:
SunPeak is based in Madison, Wisconsin, and provides commercial solar photovoltaic solutions across the Midwest and beyond. The company has completed installations in over a dozen states, with extensive project experience throughout Wisconsin and Illinois.

As a full-service commercial solar PV provider, SunPeak specializes in the design, installation, and maintenance of commercial systems. The firm operates as a union contractor that self-performs all installations using its own in-house team of account managers, engineers, project managers, electricians, and construction personnel. Every project uses a standardized combination of tier-one solar panels, inverters, and racking selected for proven field reliability. SunPeak also delivers ongoing operations and maintenance support for the life of each system, backed by 24/7 cloud-based monitoring.

SunPeak serves businesses and organizations across multiple sectors, including manufacturing, warehousing, and construction materials. Named customers include Ashley Furniture Industries, Inc., Central Storage & Warehouse, and Thelen Sand & Gravel. The company's process, called the Roadmap to Solar, covers initial site assessment through engineering, procurement, installation, utility interconnection, and long-term operational support.

SunPeak emphasizes safety and quality as core differentiators. Its construction team maintains a zero-incident safety rating, and its quality management system includes manufacturer and independent component testing, dedicated research, and ongoing education. The company also works proactively with property insurers, and its systems have been approved by stringent carriers such as FM Global to help customers maintain existing premiums.

name: SunState Solar Inc
old_description: Help protect the environment, and your wallet, by powering your home with 100% renewable energy
about:
SunState Solar Inc operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, as a locally owned solar installation company serving the Albuquerque, Santa Fe, and surrounding areas. The business was established to provide customized solar panel installations and cutting-edge technology for residential and commercial customers, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Key personnel include Glenn Felty, who leads the team, and Ian, who serves as service manager.

The company designs, installs, and services photovoltaic systems, including battery storage and roof-integrated arrays. Its scope covers consultation, system design optimized for energy production, professional installation, permitting with utilities such as PNM and the New Mexico Energy Department, and assistance with state and federal tax incentives. SunState Solar also adopts orphaned systems, handling reconnection and upgrades for homeowners whose original installers are no longer available. The firm coordinates roof replacement when needed and provides a lifetime warranty on its work.

Customers are primarily homeowners and businesses in central and northern New Mexico seeking renewable energy solutions. The company works with equipment from manufacturers such as SolarEdge for inverters and batteries, and its projects have included whole-house backup systems up to 8.1 kW of panels with 20 kWh of storage.

SunState Solar emphasizes its local expertise and personalized approach, offering tailored consultations, efficient installations, and ongoing support. Its lifetime assurance warranty and willingness to service systems installed by others differentiate it in the New Mexico market.
